function echo<T>(input: T | [T]): T | [T] { return input; }
function toList<T>(input: T | [T]): T[] { return []; }
function optionalTuple<T>(input: T | [T, T?]): T[] { return []; }
function rest<T>(input: T | [T, ...T[]]): T[] { return []; }
function suffix<T>(input: T | [...T[], T]): T[] { return []; }
function variant<T, A extends T[]>(input: T | [T, ...A]): T[] { return []; }
console.log(echo([1,2]));
console.log(echo([1,undefined]));
const one: number[] = toList([1]);
const pair: number[][] = toList([1,2]);
const uncertain: (number | undefined)[][] = toList([1,undefined]);
const tooShort: never[][] = toList([]);
const two: number[] = optionalTuple([1,2]);
const three: number[][] = optionalTuple([1,2,3]);
const long: number[] = rest([1,2,3]);
const end: number[] = suffix([1,2,3]);
const tail: number[] = variant([1,2,3]);
console.log(one,pair,uncertain,tooShort,two,three,long,end,tail);
